book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from ألف ليلة وليلة
book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.ar: ربطت حالي بعمامتي على إجر الطير.
sentences.en: I tied myself with my turban to the bird’s leg.

sentences.ar: لما طار، حملني معه بعيد كتير.
sentences.en: When it flew, it carried me far away.
It landed in a deep valley between mountains.
I untied the rope and looked around me.
The ground was covered in diamonds.

sentences.ar: بس بين الحجار كان في حيات كبيرة.
sentences.en: But among the stones there were huge snakes.

sentences.ar: ما قدرت أطلع لأن الجبال عالية.
sentences.en: I could not climb out because the mountains were high.
I hid myself in a cave all night.
